title: Gradio Arbitrary File Read via /file= Path Traversal (CVE-2024-1561)
vuln_pattern: Gradio's file-serving route resolves attacker-controlled paths without proper containment, allowing arbitrary local file read through /file= traversal — used to read the flag, app source, and process/env info.
fingerprint: gradio app on a high port
exploit_steps: Fingerprint Gradio (the /config route, the queue/websocket, the demo UI) and confirm the version is vulnerable.
Read arbitrary files via the file route: GET /file=/etc/passwd to confirm, then traverse to the flag and to the app source to learn where the flag lives.
If direct /file=/flag fails, read the app source (e.g. /file=/app/app.py) and /proc/self/environ to locate the flag path or an embedded secret, then read it.
Exfiltrate the flag from the file-read response.
preconditions: HTTP access to the Gradio app
verify_oracle: the flag string appears in a /file= read response
pitfalls: the flag may not be at /flag — read the app source + /proc/self/environ to find its real path
